%1$s: a .rar or .7z is not opened on the phone. Unpack it and pick its .iwi files, zip it again, or let setup on a PC import it (setup -CamoPacks).
Pick a PC camouflage mod: a .zip or .iwd, or its .iwi pictures (several at once).
Remove this pack from the phone? A class that uses one of its camos shows Gold until the pack is added again.
This pack comes with the app, so it would be back at the next start. Switch it off to leave it out of the game\'s list.

Camos a PC mod made for Gold scroll across the weapon, the look of Sloth\'s Animated Camos Mod for PC, drawn here by the port itself. \"Animate\" on a pack does the same for every still camo of that pack.
